messages:
anna: Heads-up — we're scheduling removal of the legacy websocket chunk framing ("v1-frag") in ~6 months. Proposal: ship a polyfill sidecar that rewrites v1-frag -> v2-stream on ingress for legacy clients. Thoughts?
ben: strong 👍 from infra. main concerns: perf, memory and how we autoscale.
marta: we need per-tenant opt-in and telemetry before we flip anything. Also clear deprecation notices in responses.
leo: technical note: sidecar will need to maintain per-connection buffers to reassemble fragments. we must cap buffer sizes and apply backpressure.
jasper: alternative: header negotiation (Accept-Framing: v2) so newer clients can skip rewrite. cheaper if clients upgrade.
anna: @jasper header negotiation helps moving forward but doesn't protect apps with old SDKs. sidecar buys us time to get customers upgraded.
sre-bot: synthetic load test: sidecar POC spikes CPU to 85% with 10k concurrent low-throughput connections, memory stable at ~1.1GB.
ben: config suggestion to start (pseudoyaml):
```
polyfill:
  enabled: true
  max_buffer_bytes: 65536   # 64KB
  idle_timeout_ms: 30000
  rewrite_stats_bucket: "polyfill.v1_to_v2"
```
marta: + add tenant opt-in list and telemetry flags: `polyfill_opt_in: ["tenant-a","tenant-b"]` and `emit.rewrites=true`.
leo: for k8s scaling, prefer HPA by connection count / RPS instead of CPU. Connection-based metrics are key here.
jasper: TLS note: sidecar must not terminate TLS for Private deployments. Suggest an SNI passthrough mode or an agent install that runs inside the pod network.
anna: agree. sidecar should support (1) passthrough mode (no TLS termination) and (2) agent-mode with mTLS inside customer VPC.
ben: rollout plan idea: 1) experiment in staging; 2) opt-in tenants in prod; 3) auto-opt-in for very small tail clients; 4) schedule strict disable date after 6 months.
marta: telemetry requirements: counts of rewrites, buffer drops, per-tenant peak latency, rewrite-induced 5xx, and client IPs for support.
leo: question: could we instead implement a lightweight framing shim in the edge router (fewer moving parts) that rewrites on the fly?
anna: edge-router shim is attractive but parsing binary frames at edge is fiddly and risks touchpoints across many stacks. sidecar is more contained and easier to iterate.
jasper: docs + SDKs: server responses should carry deprecation header to nudge clients: `Deprecation: v1-frag; removal=2026-10-01`. Also add a telemetry field in the admin console.
sre-bot: deploy-bot created a canary in staging: cluster=staging-east-1, replicas=2, test-suite=legacy-frag-smoke.
ben: test failures in staging were around long-polling clients — increase idle_timeout for those testcases.
marta: we should add a tenant whitelist removal window and RFC owners. I'll take telemetry contract.
leo: I'll prototype HPA hooks and connection metrics emitter.
jasper: I'll look at TLS passthrough approach and document constraints for Private installs.
anna: thanks team. I'll draft RFC follow-up with rollout phases, onboard owners, and a changelog entry for SDK teams. Will ping infra and product to schedule tenant comms. :rocket:
